prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean a spray/sunless tan or UV tanning beds? Also, how close to Pleasanton do you want it (zip or neighborhood)?

If you’re not sure yet, here’s a quick checklist to help pick the best salon:

- Type: confirm spray (airbrush or booth) vs. UV tanning beds. Many people prefer spray/sunless for safety.
- Reviews: look for recent Google and Yelp reviews (last 6 months) and photos.
- Hygiene: clean booths, fresh towels, visible cleaning procedures.
- Technician training: certified spray techs or trained staff for solution selection and prepping.
- Products: reputable spray solutions (e.g., DHA-based brands), and options for shade/undertone.
- Equipment safety: modern, well-maintained beds with timers and protective eyewear (if using UV).
- Patch test: salon should offer or recommend a patch spray/test to ensure color and no reaction.
- Pricing & packages: compare single sessions vs. multi-session or membership deals.
- Availability & location: convenient hours and easy parking.
- Red flags: very cheap “too good to be true” pricing, poor lighting in booths (hard to see results), no customer photos or unwillingness to do a patch test.

If you want, tell me your preference (spray vs UV) and your exact area in Pleasanton and I’ll give a short list of top-rated salons nearby and what to ask before booking.
